answer: Cross-Epoch Action-Graph Consistency (CEAGC): each pseudonymous agent’s per-epoch task transitions (e.g., orchard-pollination, harbor-logistics, plume-monitoring) are embedded; rewards/access require its embedding to stay within a calibrated envelope across epochs and its cross-identity epoch-correlation to remain below threshold. Sybils must synthesize many distinct, long-horizon action histories that are individually stable yet mutually uncorrelated. That costs per-identity policy execution, scheduling, and detection exposure, not one-off enrollment.
